beats.text: Energy drinks and **11x** the cardiac-arrest reports?

beats.label: The data
beats.note: Samayamanthula et al., AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 abstract

beats.label: With stimulants
beats.text: **854** involved energy drinks or stimulant supplements, like **pre-workouts.**

beats.label: Vs. without
beats.text: Next to soda, shakes and bars: cardiac arrest reported about **11x** more often, heart attack **4.5x.**

beats.label: Who reported
beats.text: About **45%** of those heart reports came from adults **18 to 34.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Voluntary **reports,** not true risk. Doses and health conditions weren't known. **Not proof** the drinks caused it.

beats.label: Know your number
beats.text: Most healthy adults: up to **400 mg** caffeine a day. One energy drink can hold up to **300.**
Follow to see what's **really** in your cup, one study at a time.
